8 unit tests pass (canonical_line_assembly, vintr_signal_under_isig, no_signal_when_isig_clear, veof_canonical, verase_with_echoe, opost_nl_to_crnl, icrnl_translates_cr_to_nl, raw_mode_passthrough)
cargo test -p libcluu --features host-test line_discipline passes
